settings.heading: Meet Dr. Jing Liu
settings.body:
Developed by world-renowned Dr. Jing Liu — one of the foremost authorities in Traditional Chinese Medicine — Sleep Deeply is not just another sleep supplement.Backed by over 40 years of clinical experience and two PhDs in Natural Health Science and Traditional Chinese Medicine, Dr. Liu blends centuries of Eastern wisdom with modern scientific research to address the root cause of sleeplessness, not just its symptoms.

Through decades of treating patients worldwide, Dr. Liu perfected this herbal formulation to calm the mind, nourish the body, and restore natural balance for deep, rejuvenating rest. Each ingredient is hand-selected from time-tested Chinese herbs known for promoting relaxation, reducing stress, and supporting the body’s natural sleep cycle, without sedatives or synthetic fillers.

Recognized globally as the “Master of Masters” in China, Dr. Liu has treated world-class athletes like Muhammad Ali and Michael Phelps and thousands seeking natural healing. Her mission has always been to make authentic, clinically refined herbal medicine accessible to everyone — and Sleep Deeply is the result: a genuine healing formula designed to help you sleep better, live better, and wake restored.

settings.q: What is Sleep Deeply and how is it different from other sleep supplements?
settings.a: Sleep Deeply is an herbal sleep formula developed by Dr. Jing Liu, one of the world’s foremost authorities in Traditional Chinese Medicine. Unlike most sleep supplements that rely on melatonin or sedatives, Sleep Deeply targets the root cause of sleeplessness — imbalances in the body and nervous system — using time-tested TCM herbs refined through decades of clinical practice. It helps calm the mind, restore balance, and promote deep, restorative rest naturally.

settings.q: What makes Dr. Jing Liu’s formula unique?
settings.a: With over 40 years in the medical field, Dr. Jing Liu blends Eastern and Western expertise, holding dual PhDs in Natural Health Science and Traditional Chinese Medicine. Her Sleep Deeply formula reflects over 3,000 years of proven herbal wisdom elevated by modern clinical insight. Using a proprietary combination of synergistic herbs, Dr. Liu intentionally pairs ingredients that create beneficial herbal–herbal reactions—natural interactions that generate new, more bioavailable compounds for deeper, more restorative sleep. Every extract is crafted through a 15x concentration process, ensuring maximum potency and purity in each dose. This isn’t another generic sleep supplement — it’s a doctor-formulated therapeutic blend designed for true, holistic healing.

settings.q: What are the key ingredients in Sleep Deeply?
settings.a:
The formula features a synergistic blend of traditional Chinese herbs, including:

  • Ziziphi Spinosae (Suan Zao Ren) – calms the mind and supports restful sleep.
  • Polygalae Radix (Yuan Zhi) – reduces anxiety and restlessness.
  • Privet Fruit (Nu Zhen Zi) – strengthens the body and supports longer, deeper rest.
  • Biota Seed (Bai Zi Ren) – nourishes the heart and soothes the mind.
  • Ophiopogon Tuber (Mai Dong) – replenishes Yin energy and supports calm.
  • Poria (Fu Shen) – eases nervous tension and promotes inner peace.
  • Passionflower – helps quiet the mind and reduce overthinking.
  • Bamboo Shavings (Zhu Ru) – harmonizes digestion and clears irritability.

Together, these herbs gently realign your body’s sleep cycle without creating dependency or next-day grogginess.

settings.q: What is the recommended dose for adults?
settings.a: For adults, take 2 capsules before bedtime. If you experience more severe or long-term sleep challenges, you can take an additional 1-2 capsules 6 hours before bed. For sensitive users, start with 1 capsule once per day to assess comfort before increasing your dose. For best absorption, take capsules at least 30 minutes before or after meals. You can swallow the capsules or open the capsules and empty the powdered herbs into hot water (or your beverage of choice) to consume.

settings.q: Can children take Sleep Deeply? What is the recommended dosage?
settings.a:
Yes, absolutely. Here are the dosage instructions for kids: For children under 6 years of age: Half of one capsule before bed, taken 30 minutes away from meals. Open the capsule and put the herbs in your child's favorite beverage or snack (i.e. applesauce, yogurt, etc). For severe sleep issues, the other half of the capsule can be consumed 6 hours before bed.

  • For children ages 6-10: 1 capsule before bed. If they cannot swallow the capsule, you can open the capsule and put the herbs in your child's favorite beverage or snack (i.e. applesauce, yogurt, etc). For severe sleep issues, another 1 capsule can be consumed 6 hours before bed.
  • For children ages 11+: 1-2 capsules before bed. If they cannot swallow the capsule, you can open the capsule and put the herbs in your child's favorite beverage or snack (i.e. applesauce, yogurt, etc).
  • For severe sleep issues, another 1 capsule can be consumed 6 hours before bed.


Always consult your child’s pediatrician or a licensed herbalist before starting, especially if the child is on medication or has ongoing health conditions. Sleep Deeply should never be used as a replacement for prescribed medical treatment in minors.

settings.q: How soon will I feel results?
settings.a: Many users report improvement within the first few nights, some even the same day — as the herbs begin restoring balance to the nervous system. Consistency is key; Sleep Deeply works cumulatively, supporting deeper rest and better daytime energy over time.

settings.q: Will I feel groggy in the morning?
settings.a: No. Sleep Deeply promotes deep, natural rest without next-day drowsiness. It helps your body reset its internal sleep rhythm rather than forcing sedation.

settings.q: Is Sleep Deeply safe for daily use?
settings.a: Yes. Sleep Deeply is designed for long-term balance and can be taken daily. It is non-habit-forming, vegan, gluten-free, GMO-free, and made without artificial colors, sweeteners, or preservatives.

settings.q: Can I combine Sleep Deeply with other supplements or medications?
settings.a: Because Sleep Deeply uses active herbal compounds, always consult your healthcare provider before combining it with prescription medications, sleep aids, or other herbal formulas — especially those that affect the nervous system or hormone balance.

settings.q: Is it safe during pregnancy or nursing?
settings.a: It’s recommended to consult your physician before use if you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or nursing. Keep out of reach of children.

settings.q: Is Sleep Deeply tested for purity and quality?
settings.a: Absolutely. Each batch is clinically tested and manufactured in the U.S. under strict GMP standards. Sleep Deeply is Doctor-Formulated, Clinically Proven, and Scientifically Tested to meet the highest quality standards.
